title: Soposki crash ad
issue_or_message: Immigration and a fatal Ohio crash
main_visual_elements: Footage of the April 2026 multi-vehicle crash on Interstate 71 in Delaware County that killed three people (per OCJ)
main_claims: "Sherrod Brown opened our borders to dangerous illegals. The consequences were deadly... Because of him, Ohioans paid the price."
fact_check: OCJ reports the family of the victims asked the NRSC to take the ad down, saying "our grief is not raw material for a campaign".
notes: Release date approximated as early August: OCJ (2026-08-28) says the NRSC "started airing an ad earlier this month". Recorded as an approximation in notes rather than as a precise date.

title: Transgender-surgery attack ads (series featuring Aldaco)
main_claims: "Sherrod Brown supports sex changes for minors, irreversible surgery on kids like me" (on-camera testimonial by Aldaco).
fact_check: OCJ found Aldaco is not an Ohioan, was 19 at the time of surgery and was treated in Texas — the ad's "kids like me" premise does not hold.
notes: SLF is described by OCJ as one of the main groups supporting Republicans.
